study type: Retrospective comparative study of tissue samples
exposure: Early-onset preeclampsia (delivery before 34 weeks of gestation)
outcome: Laeverin protein expression (in syncytiotrophoblasts, cytotrophoblasts, and extravillous trophoblasts)
Location of laeverin expression (cell membrane, cytoplasm, or both)
cohort: The study included 72 placentas, obtained from 33 preeclamptic and 39 uncomplicated pregnancies.
finding: Laeverin is expressed in all trophoblast cell types of both normal and preeclamptic placentas, with a heterogeneous expression pattern that is not always membrane-bound.
cross-section timing: Placentas collected at the time of delivery.
